{{LiveCountdownBox|routine=A[D27 LSU Y88 -S] C[9mo -S / 3mo -S]|title=[[File:Mayor Election.png|30px|link=]] Mayor Election|subtitle=Election Period}} {{MayorWidget |headtext=yes |box_style=float:right; clear:right; margin-left:1em; }} :''Not to be confused with [[Chocolate_Rabbits#City_Rabbits|Mayor]] and [[Chocolate_Rabbits#City_Rabbits|Minister]], City Faction Rabbits.'' Mayors are [[NPC]]s that give global buffs and perks when elected by players. Mayor Elections were added in [[Changelog/2020/September 8|Hypixel SkyBlock's 0.9 Update]], with the first election taking place in {{green|SkyBlock Year 88}}. Since then, they happened regularly, with few exceptions caused by events related to {{NPCSprite|Dante}} and later {{NPCSprite|Aura}}. == Mechanic == === Elections === An election is held every SkyBlock Year ({{green|124 real-life hours}}) with {{green|{{green|5}}}} candidates. Players vote by entering the {{Zone|Election Room}} via the teleport pad in the {{Zone|Community Center}}, or calling {{NPCSprite|Clerk Seraphine}} on an [[Abiphone]], while the voting period is open. A player can cast their votes to {{green|1}} candidate per account, as opposed to per [[profile]], but they can change their chosen candidate anytime.Switching to a different profile will automatically cast the player's votes to the same candidate. If the Profile that is being switched to has fewer votes than the former, the amount of votes that candidate received is reduced accordingly. In the opposite case, players have to enter the menu again to add the additional votes to the total. * The amount of votes players can cast can be increased via: ** The player's [[File:Golden Helmet.png|21px|link=]] [[Fame Rank]]. ** {{Item|Voter's Badge}} and its upgrades. ** Doubled with the {{Item|Artifact of Control}}. ::The maximum votes a player can get is {{green|224 votes}}. * Perks Distribution, followed by Candidate Selection, will happen before an election opens (see [[#Perks_Distribution|sections below]]). * {{green|{{green|5}}}} candidates are revealed when the election starts on {{SkyDate|m=Late Summer|d=27th}} at 00:00. The election will end on {{SkyDate|m=Late Spring|d=27th}} 00:00 the following Year, at which point the candidate with the most votes will become the mayor. === Mayors and Ministers === {{Hatnote|"Ministers" redirects here, for the two onetime events tied to {{NPCSprite|Technoblade}} and {{NPCSprite|Aura}} where players were voted and chose unique perks see [[Resistance General]] and [[Minister Election]].}} * Out of the {{green|{{green|5}}}} candidates, the one with highest amount of votes will have all of their shown perks active until the end of the next election. * The leading candidate will become the Mayor and won't be able to participate in the following election. They will be stripped of their perks and one will be randomly selected the next time they appear. * The runner-up will become a Minister, activating their minister perk alongside the Mayor's perks. They will also be unable to participate in the following election, unless {{NPCSprite|Diaz}} has her {{AN|Long Term Investment}} perk active. **{{pink|Special}} Mayors cannot be Ministers. If runner-up is a {{pink|Special}} Mayor, {{NPCSprite|Mayor Nancy}} will appear in a place of a Minister instead.{{Cite Discord |staff=yes |url=https://discord.com/channels/651912910972649492/1529181650641228007/1557150637152673843 |user=mrkeith |text= 
Are we correct to assume that when Special Mayor ends up second, there will be no Minister perk?
special mayors cannot be ministers. in this case you'll see Nancy}} **This also means that {{AN|Long Term Investment}} perk doesn't work on {{pink|Special}} Mayors.{{Cite Discord |staff=yes |url=https://discord.com/channels/651912910972649492/1529181650641228007/1557160787661815859 |user=mrkeith |text= 
I guess doesn't hurt to ask, is there any special logic if Long Term Investment (the diaz perk) + minister nancy?
I think there will just be no LTI minister then, so the perk is void}} * If the elected Mayor is a {{pink|Special}} Mayor, there will be no Minister at all and {{NPCSprite|Mayor Nancy}} will appear in Minister's place in the {{Zone|Community Center}} as a placeholder. **In case of a tie, winning Mayor is determined by the candidate order.{{Cite Discord |staff=yes |url=https://discord.com/channels/651912910972649492/1529181650641228007/1557150637152673843 |user=mrkeith |text= 
What happens if 2 (or more) candidates in a mayor election have the exact same number of votes?
the heat death of the universe (its deterministic based on their candidate order)}} === Perks Distribution === All candidates have multiple possible perks — most commonly {{green|4}} perks, with {{NPCSprite|Paul}} and {{NPCSprite|Aatrox}} not being reworked into this system yet. Before an election, for all {{Blue|Regular}} Candidates (whether or not they are randomly chosen for the next election), perks are distributed in the following way: * If a candidate was elected and is running as mayor, they will have no chance to participate or gain a perk on the election. On the election they next appear in, they will reset to 1 random perk with no possibility to gain a perk. * If a candidate was not elected, all previous perks gained by that candidate are persistent (not wiped nor randomized in the future). Before the next election, whether or not they will participate the next election, they have a {{Green|50%}} chance to gain an additional perk. This chance is increased to {{Green|100%}} if they did not gain a perk in the last election they appeared in. * If a candidate was elected Minister, they will have no chance to participate in the next election unless {{NPCSprite|Diaz}} has her {{AN|Long Term Investment}} perk active. However, all the perks they had up until that point are kept. {{green|1}} random perk of each candidate, except {{Pink|Special}} ones, is selected as Minister perk. This perk will be active even if the candidate ends up second. Minister perks are determined randomly and next time a candidate appears in an election, it may differ. A {{Blue|Regular}} Candidate can participate in an election with any number of their perks. A {{pink|Special}} and One-time Candidate always participate with all of their possible perks by default.Some of {{NPCSprite|Aura}}'s ministers disabled some of her perks. === Candidate Selection === The {{Blue|Regular}} Candidates are chosen randomly from the pool of all {{Blue|Regular}} candidates, except the one who is in the office as Mayor when the election starts. When no {{pink|Special}} Candidate runs, {{green|{{green|5}}}} {{Blue|Regular}} Candidates are chosen. Special candidates participate in an election not by random chance, but every [[Time Systems|{{green|8 SkyBlock years}}]] (when the SkyBlock Year is divisible by {{green|8}}, and become a mayor the Year after). * {{pink|Special}} candidates always appear on the {{Light Purple|rightmost}} in the Election Interface. * {{green|4}} other {{Blue|Regular}} Candidates are chosen. * {{pink|Special}} Mayors follow a set order {{NPCSprite|Scorpius}} → {{NPCSprite|Derpy}} → {{NPCSprite|Jerry}} and then {{NPCSprite|Scorpius}} again, this means that each {{pink|Special}} candidate shows up in an election every {{green|24 SkyBlock years}}. * Derpy broke this pattern twice: **in the {{Green|Year 128}} {{NPCSprite|Dante}} ran instead of him; **in the {{green|Year 464}}, {{NPCSprite|Aura}} was in office, which overwrote the standard election system. * Previous and Upcoming {{pink|Special}} mayors can be seen in the table below. {| class="wikitable" |+ class="txt-nowrap" | {{pink|Special}} Candidates Timetable (Speculated) |- ! Candidate !! Previous and Next Participation |- | {{NPCSprite|Derpy}} || {{SpecialNextParticipate|Derpy}} |- | {{NPCSprite|Candidate Jerry;Jerry}} || {{SpecialNextParticipate|Jerry}} |- | {{NPCSprite|Scorpius}} || {{SpecialNextParticipate|Scorpius}} |} == Candidates == |-|Active Candidates= These Mayor Candidates may join current and upcoming mayor elections. === {{Blue|Regular}} Candidates === {{MayorList|Regular}} === {{pink|Special}} Candidates === {{MayorList|Special}} |-|Past Candidates= These Mayor Candidates participated elections in the past, but will not participate in future elections. === Retired {{Blue|Regular}} Candidates === {{MayorList|Retired_Regular}} === One-Time Candidates === {{MayorList|One-Time}} == Past and Present Elections == {{TextMessageBox |image=[[File:Jukebox.png|70px]] |text=See current and previous Elections, Results, and Statistics in detail on [[Mayor Election/Events]]. |box_color=blue }} {{TextMessageBox |image=[[File:Book and Quill.png|70px|link=]] |text=You may help by adding missing data on [[Module:Mayor/Elections/Data]] and [[Mayor Election/Alpha Hypixel Network]]. Note: The ''current Year'' is {{Clock|YYYYYY}}. The entry for election data should be the Year that ''an election takes place''. |box_color=blue }} == Interface == {{/UI}} == The Uprising == [[File:Dante Election Room.png|thumb|A Dante Election]] [[File:Dante Election Interface.png|thumb|Interface]] {{Main|Dante}} While {{NPCSprite|Dante}} was in the office after being elected, all following elections events scheduled in the [[Calendar and Events]] menu became temporarily canceled. {{Blue|Regular}} mayor elections were replaced with Dante Elections, in which all of the {{green|5}} candidates were replaced by Dante's clones — voting for any of them results in the vote being applied to all candidates. That means that the vote couldn't be changed and the election result was always {{green|100%}} for Dante. There used to be a bug where {{NPCSprite|Seraphine}} was the clerk present in the {{zone|Election Room}} instead of {{NPCSprite|Clerk Goon}}, however, it was fixed. {{Clear}} == Game Message == {| class="wikitable centertext" !Condition !Message |- class="article-row-main" |Casting/Changing a Vote |style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue|&d&l{{Dashline}} &eYou voted for\/changed your vote to &d &ein the &bYear [#] Elections&e! &eAs a &b&e, your vote counts for &a[#]&e. &d &enow has &d[#]% &eof votes with &d[#] votes&e! &d&l{{Dashline}}}}

after the election has ended |style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue|&cThis election has already ended!}} |} == On the Alpha Hypixel Network == Generally, when [[Alpha Hypixel Network]] opens, Mayor Elections are fully-functional and are held separately from the Main Server. === Mechanic === Mayor Elections on AHN run with the same principles, but independantly from those on the main server: * The results are counted separately, the candidates and their perks are picked separately. * The time that an Election starts and ends is in sync with the main server. * When the Alpha Hypixel Network is open, players can vote on its Mayor Election once per account (not per profile), regardless of whether they voted on the main server. ==== On an Alpha Network Reset ==== * At the time of a [[AHN#Alpha Network Reset|Network Reset]], {{NPCSprite|Mayor Nancy}} is the placeholder mayor for Alpha Hypixel Network until the next election. * If an election is supposed to be happening after a reset, the election feature will be disabled until the next election{{Confirm}}. See [[#Election Feature Disabled]]. ==== On a Session Opening ==== * When the Alpha Network closes and reopens without a Network Reset, all aspects of the Mayor Election will not be affected. * If an election is skipped during the downtime of the Alpha Network, it is unknown whether a random {{Blue|Regular}} candidate will be selected as mayor, or the previously elected mayor, or {{NPCSprite|Nancy}} being used as placeholder{{InfoNeeded}}. === Previous Elections === Due to the difficulty presented in recording Mayor Elections on the Alpha Hypixel Network which occasionally shuts down and reopens, it will be documented separately on [[Mayor Election/Alpha Hypixel Network]], and not integrated to the wiki's main table. == Features Disabled == === Mayor Disabled === There are some occasions during which a Mayor is disabled. This may happen when: * The previous mayor is not replaced after an election on a [[Hub]] server * The election feature is disabled on the Alpha Hypixel Network The following is the observed behavior: * When interacted, the "mayor" NPC will only give {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Mayor &f: Hello!!}} === Election Feature Disabled === On some occasions, the mayor election feature can be disabled on the Alpha Network. This is the observed behavior: * The Election Room is still present when votings happens in the main server. However, it will almost instantly teleport the player out when they attempt to get in. If there is enough ping, a player can interact with the NPCs and Ballot Box inside before it teleports you out. * Election is "closed". However, the timer outside the Election Room will still run in sync with the Main Server. * Ballot Box and Seraphine dialogue follows the version when election is closed. ** Attempting to click on the box in the middle of the {{zone|Election Room}} when the election is closed will show the message {{Dialogue|&cThe election booth is closed!}} ==Notes== * An election that starts during Year (Year X) will end during the next Year (Year X+1), as shown in the election interface ([[:File:Perks order can change.png|image proof]]). ** The election is always called "Election Year X". ** In each candidate, the sequence of a candidate's perks can change when a Year passes. However, the perks will not change. ** In each candidate, the number of years shown in "last elected" will increment when a Year passes. == Trivia == * {{NPCSprite|Derpy}} was the first candidate to have {{green|4}} perks. * {{NPCSprite|Technoblade}} is the only mayor to have {{green|5}} perks and technically {{green|11}} perks. * {{NPCSprite|Candidate Jerry;Jerry}} becoming a mayor was leaked by Minikloon on [https://twitter.com/Minikloon/status/1346646061465690116?s=20 his Twitter]. Additionally, Dctr leaked the first perk, "Perkpocalypse" on [https://twitter.com/Dctrr/status/1347023274157486081?s=20 his Twitter] a day later. * {{NPCSprite|Candidate Jerry;Jerry}}'s Perkpocalypse does not include {{pink|Special}} mayors, candidates no longer participating or {{NPCSprite|Diaz}}. * Before [https://hypixel.net/threads/hypixel-skyblock-patch-notes-0-20-3-better-mayors.5692280/ 0.20.3] {{NPCSprite|Diaz}} had only 2 perks, one of which got removed and was replaced by 3 new ones. * {{NPCSprite|Diaz}}'s perk, "Shopping Spree" also applies to [[trades]]. * {{NPCSprite|Dante}} is the only candidate to swap perks after the election. ** Although, when elected, {{NPCSprite|Barry}} had a secret bonus to all of his perks. * Barry was first elected in Year 188, 100 SkyBlock Years after the first election, making him the mayor who went the longest time without being elected. ** {{NPCSprite|Diaz}} was another {{Blue|Regular}} candidate that had never been elected before. She was elected for the first time on June 30 2021, during the Year 146 Election, making her and Barry the two mayors who went the longest without being elected. * {{NPCSprite|Barry}} and {{NPCSprite|Candidate Jerry;Jerry}} are the only candidates that buff damage. ** {{NPCSprite|Candidate Jerry;Jerry}} has +10% {{red|Combat}} and {{aqua|Miscellaneous}} stat boost. ** {{NPCSprite|Barry}} had +15% increased spell damage. * If no Mayor is elected for any reason, {{NPCSprite|Mayor Nancy}} will appear as a placeholder. * {{NPCSprite|Dante}}, {{NPCSprite|Barry}} and {{NPCSprite|Candidate Aura;Aura}} are the only candidates that had unlisted perks that were revealed when elected. *No {{pink|Special}} mayor has ever lost an election. * In Year 241 an extra mayor was added to the mayor results with 0 votes. This was the new Mayor {{NPCSprite|Finnegan}} who was added in the 0.16.1 Update ([[:File:Mayor Finnegan 0 Votes.png|image]]) * There was a theory that when {{NPCSprite|Diaz}} is elected as Mayor with the perk Long Term-investment, and a {{pink|Special}} Mayor candidate is in 2nd place, the {{pink|Special}} Mayor would have no perks for the Year, and would show up with full perks the next Year. ** This was seemingly confirmed by {{RankName|Hypixel|TimeDeo}} after '''Diaz''' received 25% of the votes against '''Derpy''', according to {{RankName|YouTube|Derailious}}. [[File:Diaz_losing_against_derpy.mp4|width=214x214]] *** This was later disproven by another admin. == Gallery == File:Mayor Stats July 2022.png|Mayor stats released on July 14, 2022 == History == {{History table |beta= {{History|0.1|Added '''Mayor Seraphine'''.}} {{History|0.8.1|Renamed '''Mayor Seraphine''' to [[Clerk Seraphine]] and changed dialogue.}} {{History|0.9|Added [[Aatrox]], [[Barry]], [[Cole]], [[Diaz]], [[Diana]], [[Foxy]], [[Marina]] and [[Paul]].|Added [[Mayor Faith|Faith]] as a placeholder mayor.}} {{History|2020/September 9|link=none|Removed [[Mayor Faith|Faith]].}} {{History|2020/October 17|link=none|Added [[Scorpius]].}} {{History|2020/December 1|link=none|Added [[Derpy]].}} {{History|2021/January 7|link=none|Added [[Candidate Jerry|Jerry]].}} {{History|2021/March 31|link=none|Added [[Dante]].}} {{History|2021/April 16|link=none|The [[Resistance Leader]] becomes Mayor, alongside the [[Resistance General]]s.}} {{History|2022/February 8|link=none|Secret Bonuses were added in [[Barry]]'s perks.}} {{History|2022/August 13|link=none|[[Barry the Wizard]] is no longer a mayor candidate.}} {{History|0.16.1|Added [[Finnegan]].}} {{History|2025/Nov 24|link=none|Added [[Candidate Aura|Aura]].}} {{History|2025/Nov 28|link=none|Replaced '''Mayor Elections''' with [[Minister Election]]s.}} {{History|2026/Jan 12|link=none|Replaced [[Minister Election]]s back to '''Mayor Elections'''.}} }} == References == {{Reflist}} == Navigation == {{Nav/Mayors}} {{Nav/Events/Mayor Election}}
